text:
Leah: Quick heads-up — kicking off the SI Field Ambassadors shadow week tomorrow. Goal: run 3 shadow sessions with 2 SIs (HW marketplace + cloud onboarding) and validate the playbook flow.
Sam: Nice. Which SIs are we prioritizing?
Leah: Priority list in the doc: VectorGrid (hardware partner), NimbusSI, and two smaller regional SIs. Link: https://drive.redwood/example/si-shadow-week (read-only).
Priya: Can we confirm we have demo accounts for VectorGrid hardware + cloud marketplace listing? Last time HW team needed another image build.
Diego: HW image build is done. I pushed the AMI to the staging account last night. Credentials in SecretsManager -> redwood/si-demo (will invite Sam + Leah).
Sam: Awesome — I'll scope the session agenda. We should cover: 1) deployment from marketplace item, 2) latency troubleshooting steps, 3) cert path for ambassador status.
Leah: Exactly. Ambassador acceptance criteria = pass two live deploys, complete the troubleshooting checklist, and submit one joint customer-facing runbook draft.
Priya: How long is the certification checklist? I want to surface any blockers before we start.
Leah: Short list, ~8 items. I'll paste the checklist here for quick visibility:
```
- Deploy from marketplace (full stack)
- Run perf test (50 reqs/min)
- Validate KV cache + batching settings
- Failover region test
- Security review (KMS integration)
- Logging + trace verification
- Submit runbook draft
- Shadow tech enablement session completed
```
Sam: Can we add 'confirm model pinning and rollback route' as well?
Leah: Good call — adding that.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: calendar invites sent for "SI Shadow — VectorGrid" 10:00-12:00 tomorrow.
Diego: I noticed the marketplace listing example still references the old instance type in the screenshot. Minor, but confusing for SIs. I'll update before EOD.
Priya: I'll run through the playbook with a new hire to surface any wording issues and send comments by noon.
Sam: For the joint announcement piece — do we want a placeholder press blurb or keep it technical-only? My recommendation: technical announcement on marketplace docs + partner blog co-auth.
Leah: Agreed. Ambassador cohort gets a co-hosted webinar + partner blog. We'll draft a short blurb after the first successful shadow session.
Sam: Scheduling note: three 2-hour sessions across two days. Draft calendar snippet below to copy into invites:
```
Day 1 10:00-12:00 — Deploy + perf
Day 1 14:00-15:00 — Troubleshooting clinic
Day 2 10:00-12:00 — Runbook co-author + cert checklist review
```
Priya: Marking Q/A owners: Sam (deploy), Diego (HW images), Leah (cert gate).
Leah: Action items: Sam finalize agenda (ASAP), Diego upload updated screenshot + confirm AMI link, Priya review playbook wording, I'll draft the ambassador acceptance email copy.
Sam: I'll also prepare a one-pager for sales with handoff steps and partner contact template.
Diego: FYI — hardware partner asked if we can include a brief network baseline test script. I'll add a small bash snippet to the runbook: `curl -sS https://internal.redwood/netcheck | jq .`
Leah: Great. If everyone is good, I'll run the first session and record it. Please join if you're free. :thumbsup:
Priya: On it.
Sam: Joining.
onboarding-bot: Note: please run the preflight script 30m before session start: `scripts/si/preflight.sh`.
Leah: Thanks all — next check-in after session 1.
